name: substrate-ui-e2e
description: Live end-to-end test harness for substrate-ui — drives the real reveal shell in real Chrome (Playwright channel:'chrome') against the real server. The observation contract's tooling, scoped to this repo and pinned by package-lock.json so it is reproducible, not an ad-hoc /tmp install. Phase 6 (2026-09-22) retired the classic tree to _deprecated/classic-tree/; the reveal shell is the only entry.

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && tsc -p harness && npm run lint && vite build
scripts.pack:dev: npm run build && npm run pack:runtime && electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.config.js -c.mac.identity=null -c.mac.notarize=false
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run pack:runtime && electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.config.js
scripts.test:py: uv run --project ../substrate python -m pytest tests/ -q -p no:cacheprovider
scripts.gates:electron: SHAKEOUT_AXIS=C SHAKEOUT_RUNS=1 npx tsx harness/shakeout/run.ts && npx tsx harness/shakeout/lifecycle_gates.ts && npx tsx harness/shakeout/transcript_follow.ts && npx tsx harness/shakeout/resume_ended_session.ts && npx tsx harness/shakeout/driver_chip_on_resume.ts && npx tsx harness/shakeout/resume_after_two_ends.ts && npx tsx harness/shakeout/graph_model_lane_on_resume.ts && npx tsx harness/shakeout/split_pane_header_inset.ts && npx tsx harness/shakeout/both_session_shapes.ts && npx tsx harness/shakeout/structure_lists_producers.ts && npx tsx harness/shakeout/session_prompt_once_across_restart.ts
scripts.test: npm run test:py && npm run test:unit && npx tsx harness/vm_smoke.ts && SHAKEOUT_RUNS=1 npm run shakeout && npm run gates:electron
